title: Surprise Event Miss Rate
dataSources: Forecasts (`forecast:personal`), journal reviews (`forecast:journal`), resolved outcomes (`forecast:resolution`), calibration scores (`forecast:calibration`), ops reviews (`forecast:ops`).
app: Personal forecasting telemetry — Metaculus personal predictions, private prediction-journal entries, and calibration-bin scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=forecast:resolution topic_name=* surprise_miss=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(surprise_miss="yes",1,0))) as matched by topic_name
| eval a_surprise_miss_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_surprise_miss_pct
description: Measures the percentage of resolved forecasts that end with a surprise miss by topic.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which topic are helping or hurting resolved forecasts.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a surprise miss` on `forecast:resolution` events and summarize the hit rate by `topic_name`.
visualization: Table of topic with percentage of resolved forecasts ending with a surprise miss.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers how often a surprise miss happens for each topic so you can see where resolved forecasts go smoothly or get stuck.
